fact: LuxDev's project page marks the programme supporting the education sector plan as closed (Clôturé), its execution period 4 May 2018 to 31 December 2025, and states that its capacity component supports following each pupil's school career through a unique identifier, towards an integrated platform for pupil tracking, staff management and school statistics, with 46.2 million euros from Luxembourg and 6 million from the European Union managed by LuxDev.
title: Appui au Plan sectoriel de l'éducation et de la formation 2017-2030
